page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, delivering 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. Cache architecture includes 32 KB L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AES-NI, and BMI2. The instance provides 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio with 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include integrated GPUs or local storage disks, and network interfaces operate with a 6 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark measurements indicate moderate multi-core throughput alongside weaker single-threaded efficiency. The instance achieved 23,524.55 on the stress-ng multi-core suite and a PassMark CPU score of 23,224.93, placing it in the middle tier of tested hardware. Single-core performance falls into lower percentiles, demonstrated by a stress-ng single-core score of 1,108.09, a Geekbench single-core score of 945.0, and poor single-threaded gzip compression at 19.1 GB/sec. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reached 98.84 GB/sec with write speeds of 48.76 GB/sec, while in-memory operations produced 22.17 million Redis SET operations per second and a PassMark database score of 8,599.55.

With its 1:8 core-to-memory ratio, ecs.se1.8xlarge offers resource density tailored to large-scale working sets rather than raw compute speed. Architectural tradeoffs involve the reliance on remote storage volumes and modest single-core throughput, which make it unsuited for latency-sensitive single-threaded tasks. It remains appropriate for in-memory caching layers such as Redis, enterprise database deployments, big data processing, and enterprise application runtimes requiring substantial RAM allocations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores) on a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor and 256.0 GB of RAM. Featuring an x86_64 architecture with 35 MB of L3 cache, AVX-512 extensions, and a 6 Gbps baseline network, the instance includes no local storage or GPUs. Benchmark results position the server in the mid-range for multi-threaded compute, scoring 23,524.55 in multi-core stress-ng tests and handling 22.17 million Redis SET operations per second. However, single-threaded processing reflects lower relative performance, as seen in a Geekbench single-core score of 945.0. Balancing large memory density against moderate execution speed, ecs.se1.8xlarge fits high-capacity in-memory databases, memory-resident analytics, caching servers, and enterprise data processing workloads.
